Those who need access to I-5 from westbound SR 520 will need to use alternate routes. Eastbound SR 520 and the SR 520 Trail are not affected by this work and will remain open.

During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic that remains on the bridge past Montlake and Lake Washington boulevards will detour to southbound I-5.
